cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then this is your training opportunity.

mechanism: A grants instruction only after B physically accepts the assigned tool, using superior control of training to transfer rightful responsibility.
confusable: D25 quietly accumulates help; D29 openly insists the task belongs elsewhere and makes B accept it rather than merely assist.
comparison: A posted bathroom duty is transferred through training; the bins alternative ends an accidental permanent favor through a public commitment.
seedUse: The existing D29-a training condition already uses S01 approval of a request as the means of handing responsibility back.
